description: In defk-jaj the sub-agent checked test/resume_test.exs by deleting each inlined callee's resume entries. Five cases failed cleanly, but removing the entries for the 'weights' callee made the forced-yield test hang. A missing or wrong resume entry should give a clean failure: add a per-test timeout and/or a bound on yields (e.g. resumes without progress) under __defk_force_yields__/1, so a test that would loop forever fails with a clear message.

comments.text: Classified nice to have (not a safety gap, not required for the verdict) by 'Which open runtime issues are safety gaps?' (defk-dtw.12).

title: Make resume tests fail instead of hang on a resume bug
